findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Not done. The new coordinator rule says to ask the owner only for Harm 3 or higher, added scope, approval or merge, or undoing an owner decision. The guide still says at line 1440 to ask the owner whenever two rounds leave tests failing or the same finding open. A repeated Harm 1 or 2 finding can reach that worker stop and trigger an owner question, contrary to the promised autonomy rule.

Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Test. The fallback examples contain only an unscored finding or note. They would still pass if a stop with both scored and unscored open rows printed a partial table, although the specified rule requires bullets for every row whenever any row lacks scores. A reviewer omitting one score in an otherwise scored round is a normal path.
